summary: Frontend-only CRM (Apple-inspired, French, in-memory) tested end-to-end. All primary flows work: onboarding, workspace creation, lead creation, lead detail panel (edit fields, status change via select, tags, notes, next action), inline column title double-click edit, add column, search filter, CSV import (upload + mapping + confirm creating 3 leads), theme toggle to dark mode, lead deletion with sonner 'Annuler' undo toast, sidebar home navigation, second workspace creation ('BTP') with proper isolation (Avocats shows 3 leads, BTP shows 0), and Escape closes detail panel. Native HTML5 drag-and-drop was not exercised via Playwright (known flaky) but the status-select alternative works.
passed: Empty state 'Créer un lead' button creates a lead card
Lead card click opens lead-detail-panel with slide-in
Company name edit updates card in real time
Status select has 6 options; changing status moves the lead
Next action date and label persist
Column title inline double-click edit ('Edited' persisted, seen on workspace card preview)
CSV import: file upload -> step 2 mapping -> confirm imports 3 leads ('3 lead(s) importé(s)' toast)
Theme toggle switches root className to 'dark' (dark screenshot captured)
Lead delete triggers sonner toast with 'Annuler' undo action
Sidebar home button returns to workspaces list
Second workspace 'BTP' created; workspace isolation verified (Avocats=3 leads, BTP=0 leads)
not_tested: Native HTML5 drag-and-drop of lead between columns (skipped due to Playwright unreliability; alternative via status select verified working)
Native HTML5 drag-and-drop of column reordering (skipped for same reason)
CSV export download (topbar-export-btn) — button visible but download not explicitly captured
Column deletion via column menu (menu opening not exercised)
